newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound averages 3.3929/3.3954 to dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound averages 3.3929/3.3954 to dlr.

text.p: Private-sector Egyptian banks said the dollar ranged from 3.3920 to 3.3940 bid and 3.3940 to 3.3995 offer in the interbank market on Sunday.

A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3929 pounds bid and 3.3954 offered. The averages compared to 3.3925 pounds bid and 3.3941 offered on Wednesday, before the Moslem feast of Eid al-Adha.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday (1000 GMT) as 3.390394 buy and 3.394992 sell.
